original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_GB_PCB1 through TEMP_GB_PCB4 as four physical GPU-baseboard PCB temperature locations, proving exact board coordinates and consistent identity, readings and states across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The GB hardware/thermal owner maps PCB1–PCB4 to physical coordinates, nearby components and airflow zones and supplies condition-specific limits; automation then passively collects and reconciles all four exact records.
manual_activity: The GB thermal owner locates each PCB probe on the board, identifies nearby GPUs/VRs/power components and airflow, and approves limits for the documented condition. The duplicate VR Web case is reviewed independently.
required_inputs: GB PCB assembly/revision and PCB1–PCB4 physical coordinate map
Probe component/type, calibration, attachment and nearby heat-source/airflow relationship
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping per probe
Units, scaling, resolution, tolerance, sampling interval, thermal lag and unavailable semantics
Approved ranges/thresholds by workload, GPU/VR power, fan state and ambient
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/board specification revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors plus passive GPU/VR/power/fan/SEL context
Independent thermal/BMC recovery and owner confirmation
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1876 and never substitute row-1693 VR-zone evidence
Enumerate PCB1 through PCB4 separately rather than querying the tilde label
Preserve probe coordinate, nearby heat sources and capture conditions with every value
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture Web evidence
Do not start workload, change GPU/VR power, fans or thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/duplicate probe, topology mismatch, stale/invalid value, unsafe thermal condition or path mismatch; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, duplicate isolation, GB PCB map and same-target identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus four exact mapped probes
Compare descriptions, values, units, states and freshness across paths
Prepare Web parity and passive GPU/VR/power/fan/ambient/SEL context
Perform no VR-zone substitution, workload/control action or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve four probe coordinates and heat-source/airflow relationships
Provide condition-specific limits and thermal-lag expectations
Confirm Web mapping and any SKU-specific N/A
Review all four probe results and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES GB PCB PROBE-PLACEMENT, OPERATING-CONDITION AND LIMIT PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a four-probe board-coordinate map annotated with nearby heat sources and airflow, then reconcile time-aligned IB/OOB/Web readings in a stable documented condition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical placement and thermal-response context so a board reading is compared to the correct limit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The same-code TEMP_VR_Zone1–6 Web case validates different sensors and cannot contribute coverage here.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Board probes may lag GPU or VR hotspots and can exchange ranking when airflow changes, so name/value parity without placement and fan context can conceal miswired sensors.

project_override_considerations: If fewer than four probes exist on a SKU, the owner must document N/A by PCB index. A probe shared with a VR zone requires an approved identity relationship; shared code or similar value is insufficient.
expected_evidence: GB assembly and four-probe coordinate/heat-source/airflow map
Probe type/calibration and SDR/entity/Sensor List/Web identity per index
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Four readings/states with units, freshness, lag, workload/power/fan/ambient context and limits
BMC Web evidence and passive GPU/VR/SEL status
Same-target proof, exit status and artifact hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1876 is internally consistent, but its code collides with the distinct row-1693 VR-zone variant. Source identity resolves the collision without merging their acceptance criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The four PCB-probe check is identifiable and can execute after the owner supplies placement and thermal criteria under ED-36.

review_improvement: Isolates the same-code VR Web variant and adds the board-coordinate, local heat-source and airflow provenance needed for meaningful PCB temperature acceptance.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PCB sensor measures a local board location, not an abstract whole-board temperature; distance from a GPU, regulator or airflow boundary determines its response and limit. Four plausible readings can still be misassigned, so physical coordinate mapping is essential to detect swapped channels.
